name: WPadmin.AI – AI Assistant for WordPress
author: wpspin

sections.description:
WPadmin.AI Assistant for WordPress helps site owners get clear answers inside the WordPress dashboard. Ask a question in plain language and get steps you can follow.

The free plugin can help with WordPress settings, plugin questions, theme guidance, WooCommerce questions, SEO questions, content help, and common troubleshooting steps. It is built to stay out of the way on page builder editing screens, including Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Oxygen Builder, Bricks Builder, Beaver Builder, Visual Composer, WPBakery, Breakdance, and similar builders.

For users who need more than written answers, WPadmin.AI Premium is available at an additional cost. WPadmin.AI Premium gives you an AI development plugin for WordPress, a test copy of your website, and a safe process to move approved changes to the live website using the one-click Sync button.

Learn more at wpadmin.ai.

Free and Premium

Free includes:

  • AI chatbox inside the WordPress dashboard
  • site-aware WordPress answers
  • troubleshooting steps
  • plugin and theme suggestions
  • content and configuration help
  • 30 monthly questions

WPadmin.AI Premium is paid access and includes:

  • everything in Free
  • no partner ads
  • Premium support
  • more usage for dashboard answers
  • the WPadmin.AI WPadmin.AI Premium
  • a test copy of your website prepared for safer AI-assisted changes
  • help with advanced troubleshooting, plugin work, theme work, and site improvements
  • one-click Sync to move approved staging changes to the live website
  • pricing: $10 for the first month, then $30 per month

What WPadmin.AI Assistant for WordPress Does

WPadmin.AI Assistant for WordPress is the everyday help layer inside the WordPress dashboard. It can help users:

  • understand plugin, theme, and WordPress settings
  • troubleshoot common WordPress errors with clear steps
  • get plugin recommendations for business goals
  • write content in a usable format
  • request code snippets for common WordPress changes
  • understand WooCommerce, forms, SEO, security, and performance questions
  • analyze attached site data on the Premium plan when data sharing is enabled

What WPadmin.AI Premium Adds

WPadmin.AI Premium is for users who need more than answers.

After setup, WPadmin.AI prepares a test copy of the live website. You can ask for deeper changes, review the work safely, test it, and move approved changes to the live website using the one-click Sync button.

WPadmin.AI Premium can help with:

  • advanced troubleshooting for WordPress sites
  • plugin and theme help
  • harder site issues that need deeper review
  • guided implementation for changes that go beyond written instructions
  • AI development for WordPress sites in a safer test copy

Premium Use Cases

  • Troubleshoot a plugin conflict that needs deeper investigation than written steps.
  • Review and improve a custom plugin or theme.
  • Build small WordPress features, shortcodes, admin tools, or theme adjustments.
  • Investigate WooCommerce, forms, SEO, cache, security, or performance issues in more detail.
  • Prepare changes on a test copy, review them, and use one-click Sync for approved changes.
  • Get AI development help for WordPress when generic public answers are not enough.

Compatibility

The free WPadmin.AI Assistant for WordPress can answer questions about public WordPress plugins and themes based on site context and publicly available information.

WPadmin.AI is compatible with popular page builders by avoiding unnecessary assistant loading on builder editing screens. Supported page builders include Elementor, Gutenberg, Oxygen Builder, Divi Builder, Bricks Builder, Beaver Builder, Visual Composer, WPBakery Page Builder, Breakdance, and similar WordPress builder tools.

WPadmin.AI also works alongside popular WordPress plugins and site tools such as WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Advanced Custom Fields, Wordfence, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, and other widely used WordPress plugins.

With WPadmin.AI Premium, all plugins and themes can be supported, including custom-built plugins, custom themes, and private site-specific code, because changes can be prepared and reviewed on a test copy before approved updates move live.

Example Uses

  • Ask why a plugin is causing an error.
  • Get help choosing a booking, form, SEO, cache, or security plugin.
  • Ask how to fix a WooCommerce checkout issue.
  • Generate content for a page, product, email, or blog post.
  • Ask for a code snippet for a common WordPress customization.
  • Use Premium data-aware answers to understand your site setup.
  • Use WPadmin.AI Premium when you need deeper help with plugin, theme, or technical site work.

Privacy and Security

  • Prompt text and site context are sent to WPadmin.AI servers to generate responses.
  • WordPress admin requests use capability checks and nonce validation.
  • License and entitlement decisions are handled server-to-server.
  • WPadmin.AI Premium requires setup and customer verification before advanced changes begin.

Privacy Policy: https://members.wpadmin.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://members.wpadmin.ai/terms-of-service

Support

  • Email: integrations@wpadmin.ai
  • Website: https://wpadmin.ai/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from your WordPress admin area.
  2. Go to Settings > AI Assistant for the WPadmin.
  3. Choose the Free plan or WPadmin.AI Premium.
  4. Start asking questions from the dashboard chatbox.

WPadmin.AI Premium setup is guided after subscription and pairing.
sections.faq:
Is this an AI assistant for WordPress?

Yes. WPadmin.AI Assistant for WordPress runs inside the WordPress dashboard and answers WordPress questions based on your site context.

Is the premium plugin an AI developer for WordPress?

Yes. WPadmin.AI Premium adds AI development help for WordPress sites. It helps with deeper troubleshooting, plugin help, theme work, and guided changes on a test copy of your website.

Does this support Codex in WordPress?

WPadmin.AI Premium is designed for users who want help making deeper WordPress changes from the WordPress dashboard. It uses AI tools for approved Premium setup where available.

Is this a WordPress MCP plugin?

WPadmin.AI is not marketed as a generic MCP server plugin. It is for WordPress users looking for practical AI help, site-aware answers, and Premium AI development help for WordPress.

Does this add Claude in WordPress or Claude Code WordPress?

Claude Code support is planned and will be released soon. Today, WPadmin.AI Premium provides AI development help for WordPress through the current Premium setup.

Does the Free plan make changes to my website?

No. The Free plan focuses on answers, guidance, suggestions, and troubleshooting steps.

What is different in Premium?

WPadmin.AI Premium is the paid plan. It adds more usage, data-aware answers, support, and the WPadmin.AI Premium for deeper WordPress help after pairing and setup.

How much is WPadmin.AI Premium?

WPadmin.AI Premium is $10 for the first month, then $30 per month.

How many sites can use one Premium license?

Each Premium license covers one WordPress site.

How many users can use one Premium license?

Unlimited users can use the license on the covered site. Pricing is not seat-based at this time.

  • Updated Premium pricing copy to $10 for the first month, then $30/month.

  • Replaced technical Premium wording with simpler language about a test copy and one-click Sync.

2.4.1

  • Improved Premium onboarding so admins finish WPadmin.AI Premium setup before continuing with the old Assistant chatbox.
  • Added a clearer chatbox call-to-action for Premium sites that still need WPadmin.AI Premium installed.
  • Redirects admins to WPadmin.AI Premium setup after successful installation and activation.
  • Keeps the Assistant minimized by default in the WordPress dashboard to reduce distraction.
  • Improves the Premium setup card layout and install retry flow.

2.4.0

  • Added self-serve WPadmin.AI Premium installation for Premium sites.
  • Premium admins are guided from Assistant settings to the Premium pairing screen after installation.
  • When WPadmin.AI Premium is active, the Assistant launcher opens the Premium page instead of loading the chat modal.
  • Improved Premium onboarding copy for pairing token and safe staging preparation.

2.3.2

  • Shortened the WordPress.org short description to stay within the supported 150-character limit.

2.3.1

  • Improved compatibility with popular page builders, including Elementor, Gutenberg, Oxygen Builder, Divi Builder, Bricks Builder, Beaver Builder, Visual Composer, WPBakery Page Builder, Breakdance, and similar WordPress builder tools.
  • Improved admin performance by preventing the assistant chatbox from loading on post, page, custom post type, and page builder editing screens where it is not useful.
  • Improved compatibility with popular WordPress plugins by reducing unnecessary assistant loading during editing.

2.3.0

  • Renamed the public plugin to WPadmin.AI – AI Assistant for WordPress.
  • Updated public copy to explain WPadmin.AI Assistant for WordPress and WPadmin.AI Premium.
  • Removed overly technical public wording and refreshed Free vs Premium positioning.

2.2.2

  • Improved chatbox stability in wp-admin.
  • Reduced duplicate chatbox loading issues on admin screens.

2.2.1

  • Improved Premium plan detection so promotional discounts do not accidentally limit Premium-only features.

2.2.0

  • Updated README and plugin readme copy to clearly explain Assistant and Premium positioning.
  • Highlighted Premium capabilities, setup requirements, and typical use cases.
  • Bumped the client plugin version to 2.2.0

2.0.4

  • Switched middleware and service links back to members.wpadmin.ai
  • Carried forward the Premium marketing updates from the staging branch into the production client release
  • Updated Premium pricing copy for the first month and monthly renewal.

2.0.3

  • Updated plugin description, use cases, and compatibility info
  • Updated tested up to WordPress 6.9.1
  • Added support banner on settings page
  • Improved plugin tags for better discoverability

2.0.2

  • Bugfix for data sharing checkbox not accounting premium plan
